description: This file defines a class 'Search' with static methods for performing string search operations ('$FIND' and 'SEARCH') in a spreadsheet calculation context. It includes methods for case-sensitive and case-insensitive searches, handling array inputs, and returns error messages or positions of found substrings.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string search operations, including case-sensitive and case-insensitive searches, with array support.

methods.name: sensitive
methods.description: Performs a case-sensitive string search ('FIND'), returning position or error message, supporting array inputs.

methods.name: insensitive
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive string search ('SEARCH'), returning position or error message, supporting array inputs.
